rule: Does a drafted body OPEN with a greeting (#2545)? Overture holds a send whose body does not (Recipient.draftIsMissingGreeting, isBlockedByGreeting), because nothing composes a greeting above the body any more. Shared by DraftGreetingCasesTests (Swift, in mac/OvertureTests/GreetingLivesInTheBodyTests.swift, DraftGreeting.opensWithAGreeting) and draftGreeting.test.ts (TypeScript, draftGreeting.opensWithAGreeting, which prepEval scores every drafted body with). The Swift side is the source of truth: it is the gate a send actually meets (#3555).
casesAreNotInvented: Every case is a string the app's own Swift tests already assert a verdict on, and each names the test it came from in `from`, so the corpus is calibrated against the predicate the send hold uses rather than against anybody's idea of it (L48).
